name: SYS_NODE_DOWN
description: Generated when node connectivity is lost.

name: SYS_NODE_UP
description: Generated when a previously unreachable node becomes reachable again.

name: SYS_NODE_UNREACHABLE
description: Generated when a node does not respond but is not confirmed down yet.

name: SYS_IF_DOWN
description: Generated when a network interface goes down.

name: SYS_IF_UP
description: Generated when a network interface comes back up.

name: SYS_THRESHOLD_REACHED
message: Threshold reached for DCI %3 on node %1: current value is %2
description: Generated when a DCI value crosses a configured threshold.

name: SYS_THRESHOLD_REARMED
message: Threshold rearmed for DCI %3 on node %1: current value is %2
description: Generated when a DCI value returns to normal after a threshold violation.

name: SYS_SERVICE_DOWN
message: Network service %2 on node %1 is down
description: Generated when a monitored network service becomes unavailable.

name: SYS_SERVICE_UP
message: Network service %2 on node %1 is up
description: Generated when a previously unavailable network service recovers.

name: SYS_AGENT_FAIL
message: Unable to connect to NetXMS agent on node %1
description: Generated when communication with the NetXMS agent fails.

name: SYS_SNMP_FAIL
message: Unable to perform SNMP request on node %1
description: Generated when an SNMP request fails to the target node.

name: CUSTOM_HIGH_CPU
description: User-defined event for sustained high CPU utilization.

name: CUSTOM_DISK_FULL
message: Disk %2 on %1 is critically full: %3% used
description: User-defined event for critically high disk usage.

name: CUSTOM_BACKUP_FAILED
description: User-defined event triggered by failed backup job script.
